content: DeskRPG (github.com/dandacompany/deskrpg, custom license, CC0/LPC sprite assets) is a Three.js/Phaser 2D-pixel multiplayer virtual office. Core loop: kanban cards assigned to AI (Hermes) profiles move through plan/execute/review/complete; completed or blocked cards auto-post structured notifications to office chat with links back to the card. NPCs can be summoned via in-app menu to discuss work; completion reports delivered by NPC walking over and via office chat. Dedicated meeting-room mode enlarges the map, fades walls, auto-follows active speaker, supports hand-raising/floor control, and exports minutes. No progression/unlock system present. Event-driven integration to an external agent gateway via authenticated REST API; Postgres or SQLite backend.
